clause.quote: A compliant KERI/ACDC genus MUST have the following codes in its Primitive and Count code tables.
clause.section: Master code table for genus/version `-_AAACAA` (KERI/ACDC protocol stack Version 2.00)

spec_conflicts.quote: size of the value in quadlets/triplets as a Base64 encoded integer. Only raw binaries with a pad size of 0 are encoded with this table.
spec_conflicts.section: Small variable-length raw-size table with 2 lead bytes
spec_conflicts.why: The description of the 6 selector's table says only raw binaries with a pad size of 0 are encoded with it, and two sentences later that all are raw binaries with a pad size of 2 with 2 lead bytes; the second agrees with the table's title and with line 539, so the first reads as a copy of line 545.

description: After a KERI 2.0 inception, an attachments group holds a generic list (-J) of one 4-byte value with code 6B (Bytes, lead size 2): 4 bytes need two lead bytes to fill whole triplets, and the code's two size characters count the 2 triplets of lead bytes and value together. The parser must take the value's length from the size characters and strip the lead bytes. The text of this table says both that it encodes raw binaries with a pad size of 0 and that it encodes those with a pad size of 2; the case follows the second, the table's title and line 539, and records the first in spec_conflicts.
title: Parse a variable-size primitive with two lead bytes
